resources.string: Search or type a web address
OmoWeb: for use while parked only
Remote: rotate / prev-next = move pointer up-down · left-right = move sideways · select = tap · back = back
Video: select = play/pause · left-right = −10 s / +10 s · back = exit full screen
YouTube and the web on your OMOWAY display, through Android Auto and OmoAuto.
Open Android Auto settings (button below, or Phone settings › Connected devices › Android Auto).
Developer mode: scroll down to Version, tap it about 10 times, then tap OK.
Tap ⋮ (top right) › Developer settings › tick Unknown sources.
Back in Android Auto settings: Customize launcher › turn on OmoWeb.
Force stop Android Auto once, then start Android Auto from OmoAuto: OmoWeb is in the launcher on the motorcycle.
Signed in to YouTube. The session is kept and also used on the motorcycle.
If Google says the browser is not secure, OmoWeb retries automatically as desktop Chrome.
Google refused this browser: retrying as desktop Chrome…
Google still refuses the sign-in in this browser. Try again later, or sign in to YouTube on a computer and use OmoWeb without an account.
Android will ask you to confirm. Your sign-in, history and settings are kept.
Allow \"Install unknown apps\" for OmoWeb, then come back and tap Install now.
Could not reach GitHub. Check your internet connection and try again.
The download was damaged (checksum mismatch) and was deleted. Try again.
The downloaded file is not a newer OmoWeb release, so it was not installed.
Not enough storage to save the update.
This copy of OmoWeb is updated by the store you installed it from.
Tap to update to the latest version.
